description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for Consul-based clustering in Orleans. It includes classes for setting up a Consul client, configuring its address and token, and validating the options.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for a Consul cluster, including the KV root folder and client creation callback. Provides methods to configure the Consul client.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsValidator`1
classes.description: Validates a ConsulClusteringOptions instance to ensure proper configuration before use.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Sets the CreateClient callback using a provided delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Configures the CreateClient callback to instantiate a ConsulClient with specified address and optional ACL token.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Internal method to validate that the CreateClient callback has been set.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation of the options, called during validation process.
